title: Schabowy mod
description: This mod adds Schabowy to minecraft
body:
This is my first mod.

# Have you ever wanted to eat Schabowy in minecraft?
I know you had (probably). Either way now you can

##  This mod adds:
- Schabowy -- restores 4,5 hunger
- Surowy(raw) schabowy -- restores 1,5 hunger
- bułka tarta -- restores 0,5 hunger but you eat it quick
- and their recipies

See gallery for crafting recipies or use mod like JEI or REI

Feel free to use this mod in a modpack
